title: Worker view pointer range destruction
summary: Walk the pointer range, decrement the adjusted counted object's reference count, and call its virtual destroy entry with flag 1 when it reaches zero.
test_description: Compare original and recovered routines for empty, single and mixed ranges containing nulls, repeated objects, counts of zero, one and greater than one. Check callback order, adjusted this pointers, flags, wrapping counts, unchanged range and neighboring fields, and FS head restoration.
known_limits: Valid forward ranges and valid object/table pointers are required; invalid ranges and exceptional virtual calls are not tested.
The identity and other entries of the view and counted-object tables remain unresolved.
The callback is controlled test code and does not model actual object deletion.
